league.passiveEffect: -10% max HP. Every 8 s you howl: for 4 s you deal ×1.15 damage (your support Alphas too) and take ×0.8 damage. Your Fire hits heal you a little. As Houndoom, your burns last 50% longer.
league.unlock: Burn 2,000 Pokémon in a single run with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: +20 armor and -10% attack speed. When you slide you curl up and roll for 1.5 s, trampling and stunning everything you touch. As Donphan, you roll faster and wider.
league.unlock: Get 8,000 KOs in Ecruteak City with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: -10% max HP and you take ×0.9 damage. Every 6 s your antlers create two copies of you: they pull enemies in for 3 s and burst, confusing them.
league.unlock: Evolve 15 times during your runs with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: -15% max HP. You can learn moves from the kits of the whole League, of any type. The color of your brush changes every 6 s and your Normal-type moves take on that type (and its status and effectiveness). Trump Card hits harder with every cast in a row.
league.unlock: Have 20 Johto members in your League. · Play with 12 different Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: +10% physical damage. Every 150 enemies defeated, +1% damage for the run (up to +15%). In exchange, -10% max HP.
league.ultimate: Practical Lesson → Masterclass → The Three Masters
league.unlock: Evolve 15 times with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: +10% evasion and -10% max HP. Your Spins deal ×1.25 damage and, while you spin (1 s), you deflect enemy projectiles and send them back.
league.unlock: Have 12 Johto members in your League. · Defeat 15 Alpha Pokémon with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: +20% status chance. Every 5 s it blows a kiss at the nearest enemy and charms it; charmed enemies take ×1.25 damage. In exchange, -10% max HP.
league.ultimate: Icy Little Kiss → Polar Kiss → Glacier Kiss
league.unlock: Freeze 5,000 Pokémon with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: +10% speed. Running spins its arms and charges it up: every 60 m, a discharge jumps to 4 nearby enemies and may paralyze them. In exchange, -10% max HP.
league.ultimate: Full Plug → High Voltage → Power Plant
league.unlock: Paralyze 1,500 Pokémon in a single run that you start with a Johto Pokémon (Dunsparce paralyzes).

league.passiveEffect: Every 10 s it throws a tantrum: burns everything within 4.5 m and deals ×1.25 damage for 3 s. In exchange, -10% max HP.
league.ultimate: Big Tantrum → Volcano Mouth → Stomping Eruption
league.unlock: Burn 1,500 Pokémon in a single run with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: +20% max HP and you take ×0.75 damage from Fire and Ice (Thick Fat). Every 15 s you leave a bottle of milk nearby; picking it up heals you for 15%. Milk Drink and Heal Bell heal you, and Wake-Up Slap deals ×1.6 damage to sleeping enemies. In exchange, -10% damage.
league.unlock: Have 15 Johto members in your League. · Recover 30,000 HP with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Running at over 80% of your speed you leave a trail of lightning that paralyzes anyone who steps on it.
league.unlock: Have 30 Johto members in your League. · Fill Raikou's tracking gauge in Ecruteak City with Johto Pokémon. · Paralyze 1,500 Pokémon in a single run that you start with a Johto Pokémon (Dunsparce paralyzes).

league.passiveEffect: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Every 6 s a volcano (a 3 m pillar of fire) erupts under the strongest enemy and burns it.
league.unlock: Have 32 Johto members in your League. · Fill Entei's tracking gauge in Ecruteak City with Johto Pokémon. · Burn 3,000 Pokémon in a single run with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Every 5 s the north wind purifies: it heals you for 2% of your HP and wets and slows enemies within 7 m.
league.unlock: Have 34 Johto members in your League. · Fill Suicune's tracking gauge in Ecruteak City with Johto Pokémon. · Freeze 1,500 Pokémon in a single run with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: +20 armor (Pupitar, +30). You carry a sandstorm with you (6 m; Tyranitar, 9 m) that deals little damage, and your Rock moves deal ×1.15 damage. With Sandstorm the aura is 30% bigger and deals double damage. -10% speed.
league.unlock: Have 25 Johto members in your League. · Win in Ecruteak City on Hard with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Every 7 s a sea whirlpool (5 m) opens under the densest group: it pulls it in, wets it and hits it. With weather, Weather Ball deals ×1.4 damage and gives you its status; Whirlwind pushes the horde back.
league.unlock: Have 40 Johto members in your League. · Capture Raikou, Entei and Suicune. · Win in Ecruteak City on Nightmare with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Once per zone (in Survival, every 5 min), when you faint you are reborn with 50% of your HP in an explosion of rainbow fire. With Safeguard, status effects don't affect you.
league.unlock: Have 40 Johto members in your League. · Capture Raikou, Entei and Suicune. · Defeat Ho-Oh atop the Tin Tower on Hard with Johto Pokémon.

league.passiveEffect: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Every 30 s you can rewind: you recover the HP you had 5 s ago (if it was higher). It is ready as soon as you have lost HP.
league.unlock: Capture the other Johto members of the League.

fusions.name: Flower Beam
fusions.description: Gathers sunlight and fires a solar beam from which sharp leaves sprout on both sides; where it ends, an explosion of petals blooms.

fusions.name: Fiery Whirlwind
fusions.description: Launches a fire whirl that pulls in enemies and feeds it with a Flamethrower: it grows, spits spiraling flames and explodes.

fusions.name: Hydro Spiral
fusions.description: You spin inside your shell and push nearby enemies away while two Hydro Pump jets sweep everything around you like a sprinkler.

fusions.name: Ball Storm
fusions.description: Launches a big electric ball that floats over the horde and acts as a lightning rod: thunder strikes it and chains outward until it falls and explodes.

fusions.name: Resonant Web
fusions.description: Throws silk webs that stick to the ground and trap; then a buzz makes them vibrate and each web releases a sound wave that punishes the trapped more.

fusions.name: Lethal Sting
fusions.description: Calls a swarm of Beedrill that dive with their stingers; where they sting they leave toxic spikes on the ground.

fusions.name: Feather Cyclone
fusions.description: A hurricane advances on the enemies dragging them along, and cutting wings fly out of it nonstop, back and forth.

fusions.name: Ravenous Chomp
fusions.description: Fangs leap from enemy to enemy biting each one; each bite also tears away 6% of its remaining health (not bosses).

fusions.name: Celestial Drill
fusions.description: A drill beak falls from the sky onto the enemy, sinks into the earth and comes out again beneath three others, one after another.

fusions.name: Corrosive Grime
fusions.description: A pile of garbage falls on the enemies and leaves an acid puddle that poisons and corrodes: those who step in it take more damage.

fusions.name: Seismic Ball
fusions.description: A rock ball rolls in circles around you; each bounce shakes the ground and at the end it lands with a great earthquake.

fusions.name: Toxic Tide
fusions.description: A wave of poison leaves you in a circle; enemies that were already poisoned burst into splashes that infect those beside them.

fusions.name: Tectonic Horn
fusions.description: A ghostly horn charges in a straight line and splits the ground: along the fissure, earth geysers burst one after another.

fusions.name: Gravitational Moon
fusions.description: A small moon appears over the enemies and pulls them in with its gravity; then it falls and bursts into star shards.

fusions.name: Nine-Tail Dance
fusions.description: Nine will-o'-wisps spin around you like tails and launch one by one at the enemies; each bursts into a ring of psychic fire that burns and confuses.

fusions.name: Grand Concert
fusions.description: A lullaby puts the surrounding enemies to sleep and, once they are asleep, a huge booming voice hits them hard and wakes them.

fusions.name: Vampire Wing
fusions.description: A supersonic echo marks the surrounding enemies and air blades seek the marked and return part of the life they steal.

fusions.name: Dancing Garden
fusions.description: The petals spinning around you open into a spiral storm and close again; they hit on the way out and back and leave clouds of poison dust.

fusions.name: Fungal Bomb
fusions.description: Throws energy balls that make a mushroom sprout where they land; the mushroom releases sleep spores and soon bursts.

fusions.name: Scale Prism
fusions.description: Releases a cloud of silver scales ahead and fires a signal beam at it: the scales refract it into a fan of colored beams.

fusions.name: Dugtrio's Fissure
fusions.description: A fissure runs along the ground toward the enemies; along it Diglett and Dugtrio pop up and spit mud at those nearby.

fusions.name: Golden Rain
fusions.description: Coins rain on the surrounding enemies, then you leap into a playful scuffle in a dust cloud where they pile up most.

fusions.name: Torrential Migraine
fusions.description: A jet soaks the enemies ahead and Psyduck's headache bursts into psychic orbs on the wet ones, splashing those beside them.

fusions.name: Unleashed Tantrum
fusions.description: Throws fists of rage that chase the enemies, and every hit makes the ground tremble. The less health you have left, the harder it hits.

fusions.name: Fiery Stampede
fusions.description: A fire silhouette leaves you at full speed and zigzags between several enemies leaving a burning trail; at the end it explodes.

fusions.name: Hypnotic Spiral
fusions.description: A great hypnotic spiral turns on the ground and pulses, lulling enemies to sleep, while bubble beams spiral out of it.

fusions.name: Prismatic Premonition
fusions.description: Marks several enemies with runes; shortly after, rifts open in the air around them and Psybeams converge on them.

fusions.name: Four-Arm Combo
fusions.description: Four lightning-fast strikes in a cross against four enemies and, to finish, a Dynamic Punch whose shockwave confuses everything nearby.

fusions.name: Carnivorous Whip
fusions.description: Throws vines that catch up to three enemies and drag them toward you; then acid jaws bite everything around you.

fusions.name: Jellyfish Whirl
fusions.description: A whirlpool pulls in the enemies; tentacles sprout around it and poison jumps in a chain among all the trapped.

fusions.name: Magnitude 10
fusions.description: An earthquake of random magnitude between 4 and 10: the higher it is, the harder it shakes and the more rocks fall from the sky.

fusions.name: Gloomy Curse
fusions.description: A Shadow Ball bursts and curses; then misfortune jumps from enemy to enemy with will-o'-wisps and deals double damage to those suffering any status.

fusions.name: Dance of Bones
fusions.description: A bone and a dark bone trace figure eights around you, hitting everything they cross; the dark one leaves a trail of ghostly fire.

fusions.name: Celestial Cross Slash
fusions.description: Four giant air slashes arrive from the corners and cross in an X over the enemy, where they burst into a gale of blades.

fusions.name: Gyarados's Fury
fusions.description: A waterfall bursts from the ground, Gyarados emerges from it and sweeps a huge arc with a Hyper Beam.

fusions.name: Glacial Tide
fusions.description: A wave advances and freezes as it goes into a wall of ice that soon bursts into freezing shards.

fusions.name: Star Gambit
fusions.description: Meteors' stars spin around you, gather over the enemy and fall as a giant star of your current form's type.

fusions.name: Crushing Nap
fusions.description: A huge shadow grows over the enemies and Snorlax drops like a stone: the ground trembles in waves and, after the blow, it takes a little nap that heals you a bit.

fusions.name: Draconic Rain
fusions.description: You fire a Dragon Pulse into the sky that splits into a rain of draconic comets on the enemies; each one leaves violet fire.

fusions.name: Primeval Bubble
fusions.description: A pink bubble grows over the enemies and traps them inside; when it pops, it strikes them with psychic force and moonlight.

fusions.name: Sacred Gallop
fusions.description: A fire Rapidash gallops between the enemies leaving burning hoofprints, and columns of sacred fire fall in its wake.

fusions.name: Psychic Geyser
fusions.description: A psychic ring expands from you and, as it passes, geysers of boiling water burst that burn and confuse.

fusions.name: Magnetic Field
fusions.description: Magnets stick to several enemies and pull them against each other; then a Flash Cannon pierces the pile.

fusions.name: Starry Leek
fusions.description: The leek falls from the sky like a meteor wrapped in feathers and stars, and its impact releases a shockwave and shooting stars.

fusions.name: Triple Ruckus
fusions.description: Three heads peck three different enemies at once, three times in a row, while their racket stuns everyone around.

fusions.name: Aurora Borealis
fusions.description: Aurora curtains descend from the sky and sweep over enemies, freezing them; then a polar chill bursts and deals double damage to the frozen.

fusions.name: Sludge Tide
fusions.description: A sludge belch floods the ground in front of you and leaves toxic puddles that spit waste balls at nearby enemies.

fusions.name: Icicle Rain
fusions.description: Fires icicles into the sky that fall in a circle on the enemies and stay stuck for a moment; at the end a giant icicle drops.

fusions.name: Rock Snake
fusions.description: A rock serpent advances underground in a zigzag: its rocks burst the ground as it passes and leave sharp stone traps.

fusions.name: Dreamy Feast
fusions.description: A pendulum puts surrounding enemies to sleep and steals their dreams: energy beams run from the sleepers to you, damaging them and healing you.

fusions.name: Tsunami Claw
fusions.description: A giant claw falls from the sky and strikes the ground; the impact sends out a wave that wipes out everything ahead of you.

fusions.name: Chain Reaction
fusions.description: Drops Voltorbs around you that sizzle and explode one after another: each explosion sets off the next.

fusions.name: Explosive Harvest
fusions.description: Throws eggs that burst into seeds; a palm tree sprouts from each one and crashes down on the surrounding enemies.

fusions.name: Hurricane Kick
fusions.description: A flurry of spinning kicks raises a whirlwind that advances on the enemies; at the end, a kick falls from the sky like a meteor.

fusions.name: Glacial Fist
fusions.description: Focuses power into an icy fist that freezes the enemies ahead; a second precise blow shatters them.

fusions.name: Giant Lick
fusions.description: A huge tongue sweeps an arc in front of you, catches the enemies and slams them into the ground with all its weight.

fusions.name: Detonating Cloud
fusions.description: Clouds of toxic smoke spread among the enemies and poison them; then they ignite and explode one after another.

fusions.name: Megalithic Charge
fusions.description: A ghost rhino charges in a straight line trampling everything; at the end of its run a huge boulder falls.

fusions.name: Sonic Egg
fusions.description: Throws lucky eggs that crack open with a bang: each one releases sound waves and a bit of energy that heals you.

fusions.name: Solar Tangle
fusions.description: Vines catch nearby enemies and drain their life; then a blade of sunlight cuts all the entangled.

fusions.name: Parental Double
fusions.description: Mother and child attack together: a Mega Punch and a Mega Kick on the same enemy, twice in a row, and every blow shakes those around.

fusions.name: Abyssal Ink
fusions.description: Fires ink balls that blind enemies; shortly after, a Hydro Cannon falls from the sky onto each ink stain.

fusions.name: Torpedo Horn
fusions.description: A water torpedo with a steel horn chases the enemies, pierces them one after another and ends with a bite that raises a wave.

fusions.name: Photon Star
fusions.description: A water star spins toward the enemies and, as it spins, fires beams of light in all directions; when it stops, it bursts into a geyser of photons.

fusions.name: Explosive Wall
fusions.description: Raises four crystal panels that enclose a group of enemies and sets off a fairy mist inside the box.

fusions.name: Glacial Kiss
fusions.description: Throws kisses that put enemies ahead to sleep and charm them, then blows an icy breath that freezes the kissed.

fusions.name: Flashing Cage
fusions.description: Traps a group in a cage of lightning that paralyzes them and unleashes a Discharge from the sky inside it.

fusions.name: Volcanic Eruption
fusions.description: A volcano rises from the ground in front of you, belches burning smoke and spits lava bombs that rain around it.

fusions.name: Titanic Guillotine
fusions.description: Grabs the nearest enemy with its horns, flips it and hurls it into the horde: where it lands, a brutal shockwave bursts.

fusions.name: Stampede
fusions.description: Calls a herd of Tauros that charges the enemies one after another: each goring blow lifts the ground and sends them flying.

fusions.name: Metamorfusion
fusions.description: Ditto transforms with every cast: it copies the signature fusion of a random League member.

fusions.name: Binary Overload
fusions.description: Three data cubes orbit around you linked by Fusion Bolt arcs and fire Techno Blasts at nearby enemies.

fusions.name: Ancient Deluge
fusions.description: The shell gathers water and fires a meteor beam into the sky; the sky answers with torrents of water and rocks on the enemies.

fusions.name: Fossil Slash
fusions.description: Two scythes slash in a cross in front of you, and sharp spinning shells fly out of the cut, piercing the enemies.

fusions.name: Prehistoric Dive
fusions.description: A winged shadow dives from the sky with electric fangs and crashes in a paralyzing blast.

fusions.name: Ice Age
fusions.description: An icy gale of ice feathers sweeps what is ahead and behind it a wave of ice covers the ground and freezes the enemies.

fusions.name: Supreme Storm
fusions.description: Charges and fires an electro beam that pierces everything; wherever it passes a storm breaks out and lightning strikes along its path.

fusions.name: Phoenix Sun
fusions.description: A fire phoenix dives onto the enemies and bursts into a small sun that scorches everything.

fusions.name: Genetic Supremacy
fusions.description: Psychic fragments spin around you and lodge in the enemies; then a Psyshock falls and mind-wave beams cross it in a star shape.

fusions.name: Ancient Forest
fusions.description: Four rows of roots spread out in a cross and at the end of each one a trunk grows and bursts into splinters.

fusions.name: Igneous Wall
fusions.description: A line of fire pillars advances and at the end closes into a ring of explosions.

fusions.name: Tide of Jaws
fusions.description: A jaw-shaped wave advances dragging enemies along and at the end bites everything it carries.

fusions.name: Ambush
fusions.description: You leave three Sentret decoys that draw in the horde and, when it crowds together, Furret bursts out of the ground under each one.

fusions.name: Eyes of the Night
fusions.description: Two huge eyes open above the horde and paralyze it with their gaze; then Noctowl dives from the center.

fusions.name: Flock of Fists
fusions.description: A swarm of Ledian surrounds each nearby enemy and riddles it with punches from their star fists.

fusions.name: Deadly Web
fusions.description: You weave webs under nearby enemies: when someone is caught, the web bursts into poisonous X-shaped slashes.

fusions.name: Lantern Cannon
fusions.description: You throw lanterns of light that bounce between enemies and, on the third bounce, burst like a Zap Cannon that paralyzes.

fusions.name: Rain of Wishes
fusions.description: Five flashes of fairy light leave you in a chain and each one summons a random League move on a different enemy.

fusions.name: Sun Eye
fusions.description: A huge eye opens above the horde, marks it and fires a sunbeam that sweeps the field.

fusions.name: Electric Cotton Cloud
fusions.description: A cotton cloud traps the horde, the beacon's beam lights it up and the cloud discharges everything it has stored.

fusions.name: Bubble Concert
fusions.description: You sing: each note creates bubbles that bounce to an enemy, drain its life and burst in a chain on the next one.

fusions.name: Stone Felling
fusions.description: Plants branch barriers that trap a group and turn them into stone logs that fall on the trapped enemies.

fusions.name: Pollen Gale
fusions.description: A cyclone of leaves and cotton gathers pollen balls and throws them across the field: each one bursts into a cloud that poisons.

fusions.name: Juggling
fusions.description: The tail juggles five objects above your head (stone, berry, Poké Ball, smoke bomb and coin) and throws them one by one at the enemies: each with its own effect.

fusions.name: Midday
fusions.description: The sun reaches its peak above the horde and a huge chlorophyll beam falls from it, scorching the ground, with smaller beams on nearby enemies.

fusions.name: Stomp
fusions.description: A supersonic charge leaves rings of sound in its wake, and when it ends they burst one after another in a chain, breaking everything they enclose.

fusions.name: Seismic Swamp
fusions.description: The mud spreads into a swamp that slows enemies and the earthquake makes it erupt in mud geysers all over the swamp.

fusions.name: Master Thief
fusions.description: A feather marks the strongest enemies; the crows carry them off into the air, stealing their PokéDollars, and drop them from on high.

fusions.name: Procession of Souls
fusions.description: A procession of will-o'-wisps surrounds you and each one chains an enemy with a soul bond that steals its life and gives it to you; at the end, the souls burst.

fusions.name: Lost Word
fusions.description: A portal spits out letters of every type that form a word in the air and, when it finishes writing it, each letter bursts with the color of its type.

fusions.name: Final Replica
fusions.description: For 2.4 s every hit you take leaves a mirror mark; at the end they all burst at once, harder the more damage each hit did to you.

fusions.name: Double Resonance
fusions.description: The two beams leave each head, cross in front and, where they cross, a psychic wave bursts and repeats in echoes.

fusions.name: Minefield
fusions.description: You sow a row of Spikes in front of you and fire a steel laser that makes them burst one after another in a chain.

fusions.name: Telluric Drill
fusions.description: The drill bores through the ground in a straight line and the pulse bursts along the crack with the type of the map's terrain.

fusions.name: Celestial Stinger
fusions.description: Grabs a group of enemies, lifts them into the air and stabs them with the poisoned tail mid-air before dropping them.

fusions.name: Canine Terror
fusions.description: Pulls a scary face that frightens the horde and, as it flees, gives it a beating of punches and bites at point-blank range.

fusions.name: Toxic Barrage
fusions.description: You spit a poison water ball that, on reaching the enemy, bursts into a barrage of spikes in every direction.

fusions.name: Sticky Shell
fusions.description: Your shell bursts in a wave that throws enemies backward and, from among the pieces, sticky nets come out that trap the horde.

fusions.name: Missile Horn
fusions.description: You charge with your horn out in front and, at the end of the charge, a fan of needles shoots from the tip, piercing enemies.

fusions.name: Pack Ambush
fusions.description: The pack comes out of the shadows, surrounds an enemy and they all land a Wicked Blow at once: every hit is a critical.

fusions.name: Lunar Roar
fusions.description: You beat the drum under a red moon and each drumbeat fires a crimson beam from the moon onto an enemy and curses it.

fusions.name: Cauldron
fusions.description: A magma whirlpool traps the horde and, around it, leaves trap shells that burst into lava geysers.

fusions.name: Rolling Avalanche
fusions.description: A snowball starts rolling in front of you and grows without stopping until it is a glacier that flattens everything and crashes at the end in an explosion of ice.

fusions.name: Crystal Coral
fusions.description: You throw coral gems that stick into the enemies, grow into pink crystals and, after a moment, burst into splinters that hurt those around.

fusions.name: Ink Cannon
fusions.description: The cannon fills with ink and fires a black jet at high pressure that pierces the line; at the end it opens into a wave of ink that blinds the whole cone.

fusions.name: Sack of Gifts
fusions.description: A huge sack falls from the sky on the enemies with an avalanche of snow and opens: gifts fly out and burst into confetti all over the field.

fusions.name: Great Surf
fusions.description: You leap out of the water three times in a row, each time farther, and on the last splash you raise a giant wave that sweeps away everything in front of you.

fusions.name: Sword Gale
fusions.description: A whirlwind of sword feathers advances across the field dragging and cutting everything it touches, and at the end bursts in a rain of blades.

fusions.name: Hellfire
fusions.description: Each lash of the tail leaves a black flame on the ground that, a moment later, bursts in a pulse of darkness.

fusions.name: Seismic Roll
fusions.description: You spin like a wheel of flames and, with each turn, the ground rises in a wave of earth that sweeps the field.

fusions.name: Illusory Stampede
fusions.description: Stantler copies charge ahead leaving a trail of mist and, at the end of the dash, they all burst into a cloud that confuses.

fusions.name: Final Canvas
fusions.description: You paint a four-color circle on the ground and each color falls like a bolt of its type; at the end, a huge splash closes it in the center.

fusions.name: Wrecking Top
fusions.description: You spin sweeping the ground and, at the end of each turn, your leg comes down like an axe on an enemy and cracks the earth; three turns in a row.

fusions.name: Milky Roll
fusions.description: A slap clears the way for Miltank, which rolls in a spiral as a steel wheel: every enemy it catches is flung away and, at the end, it crushes the ground.

fusions.name: Beastly Lightning
fusions.description: Raikou runs from enemy to enemy leaving a trail of lightning and falls on each one like a bolt; the last slam unleashes a thunderclap.

fusions.name: Volcanic Fury
fusions.description: Entei charges three times wrapped in flames and each charge ends in an eruption that splits the ground.

fusions.name: Purification of the North
fusions.description: Beams of pure water shoot out of Suicune in every direction and leave frost on the ground that freezes; a breath from the north finishes it.

fusions.name: Tectonic Bite
fusions.description: You bite the ground with jaws of rock and from the bite, in a line, pillars of sharp rock burst out and send enemies flying.

fusions.name: Eye of the Hurricane
fusions.description: A sea hurricane of rain and foam drags enemies toward its center and, right then, the Aeroblast crosses it from side to side.

fusions.name: Rainbow Fire
fusions.description: The beak turns red-hot and fires sacred fireballs of seven colors in a fan; each one bursts where it lands and burns.

fusions.name: Forest of Time
fusions.description: Leaves from another time appear frozen in the air in front of you and a beam of light seeds crosses them: each leaf bursts as soon as the beam touches it.

fusions.name: Volt Cheek Rush
fusions.description: A wake of current zigzags out of your cheeks and leaves sparks that burst all at once.

fusions.name: Constellation
fusions.description: The stars around you rise into the sky, draw a constellation and come down as meteors.

fusions.name: Eternal Lullaby
fusions.description: You sing two verses: notes fly out in a circle and put to sleep whatever they touch, and on the second verse those already asleep are blown away.

fusions.name: Spinning Press
fusions.description: You spin in the air kicking and come down in a press: the blow cracks the ground in a star.

fusions.name: Frozen Heart
fusions.description: You fix your gaze ahead and a row of ice hearts forces its way through: as they break, they charm and freeze.

fusions.name: Plasma Whirl
fusions.description: You spin your arms non-stop: a whirl of current follows you, and when released two claps burst around you.

fusions.name: Volcanic Tantrum
fusions.description: Fireballs build up over your head until they all burst at once and shoot out in a circle.

fusions.name: Hyper Star
fusions.description: A huge star falls from the sky onto the nearest enemy and its shockwave sends shooting stars in all directions.

fusions.name: Scorching Sun
fusions.description: A small sun forms above the enemies, flames rain around them and it finally bursts in a ring of fire.

fusions.name: Tidal Wave
fusions.description: A circular wave leaves you and sweeps everyone along, and behind it geysers burst under the enemies.

fusions.name: Primeval Forest
fusions.description: Six thorny roots run along the ground in a star shape, trap whatever they cross, and where they end a tree sprouts and drops leaves.

fusions.name: Electric Storm
fusions.description: For a few seconds lightning strikes nonstop on the enemies around you, paralyzing them.

fusions.name: Eternal Blizzard
fusions.description: A blizzard spins around you and freezes; at the end ice crystals sprout under the frozen and burst.

fusions.name: Thousand Fists
fusions.description: A rain of punches falls on nearby enemies one after another and ends with an uppercut that cracks the ground.

fusions.name: Toxic Swamp
fusions.description: Throws four sludge bombs that leave toxic puddles; the puddles bubble and poison nonstop.

fusions.name: Seismic Fault
fusions.description: You stomp hard: three cracks run along the ground toward the enemies and burst into columns of earth.

fusions.name: Typhoon
fusions.description: A tornado advances on the enemies dragging them along and hitting them nonstop, with sharp feathers flying off.

fusions.name: Mind Warp
fusions.description: Three psychic waves leave you: the first pulls enemies in, the second confuses them and the third crushes them.

fusions.name: Swarm
fusions.description: A swarm of insects bursts from you and rushes at nearby enemies, stinging and poisoning.

fusions.name: Meteorite Shower
fusions.description: Flaming rocks fall from the sky onto the surrounding enemies; each one bursts into shards.

fusions.name: Spectral Parade
fusions.description: Eight will-o'-wisps spin around you and launch one after another at the enemies, burning and cursing.

fusions.name: Ancestral Fury
fusions.description: You roar and dragon flames rain on the enemies; where they land they leave violet fire.

fusions.name: Pitch Black
fusions.description: Darkness falls around you and shadow claws tear through every enemy trapped in it, one after another.

fusions.name: Steel Rain
fusions.description: Six steel blades spin around you striking those nearby and then shoot out at the enemies.

fusions.name: Fairy Halo
fusions.description: A halo of light surrounds you and pulses three times: it charms enemies, hits them and heals you a little.

fusions.name: Conductive Storm
fusions.description: A rain soaks the surrounding enemies and lightning jumps among all the wet: causes nonstop Electrocuted.

fusions.name: Boiling Geyser
fusions.description: Geysers of boiling water burst under the enemies and leave steam clouds that confuse and slow them.

fusions.name: Fiery Gale
fusions.description: A gale of burning leaves sweeps a huge cone in front of you and sets the ground ablaze: causes Inferno.

fusions.name: Shattered Glacier
fusions.description: You encase nearby enemies in ice and a brutal blow shatters it: causes Wreckage.

fusions.name: Toxic Combustion
fusions.description: You exhale a cloud of poison gas that spreads toward the enemies; a spark ignites it and it explodes: causes Poison Gas.

fusions.name: Eternal Sleep
fusions.description: A pendulum puts surrounding enemies to sleep and shadow hands strike the sleepers: causes Nightmare and heals you.

fusions.name: Psychic Spark
fusions.description: Four psychic orbs orbit around you linked by electric arcs that strike whatever they cross: causes Psychic Meltdown.

fusions.name: Enchanted Breath
fusions.description: A rain of hearts charms the enemies ahead and a dragon breath devastates the charmed: causes Dragon Rage.

fusions.name: MissingNo.
fusions.description: It's what you get from two unrelated moves (different types, with no reaction or signature fusion). It works: each time it's cast it becomes a random type's fusion, surrounded by corrupted blocks.
